suggestions.topic: EIP-8365: Finalize 0x00 deposit handling (burn vs. re-queue)
suggestions.rationale: Deferred from ACDC #190 with explicit two-week revisit window for post-Devcon decision. Core teams need to choose between burning ETH from post-fork 0x00 deposits or implementing Barnabas' re-queue proposal.

suggestions.topic: PQ signature scheme public commitment and ecosystem communication
suggestions.rationale: ACDC #191 consensus identified this as top priority to enable validator, hardware wallet, and staking pool migration planning. LeanVM audit timeline (Feb 1 start) creates urgency for scheme finalization.

suggestions.topic: consensus-specs PR#5770 decision following ACDT/Sepolia resolution
suggestions.rationale: Deferred from #191 pending EL clarity on 8037/8038 and cross-layer ePBS payload handling discussion at Monday ACDT. Decision needed to unblock execution payload gossip validation alignment.
Status contested in #191 with PQ interaction and DC compatibility unclear. Core to Hegota sequencing strategy discussed in #190; CL complexity assessed as manageable but requires final go/no-go.

suggestions.topic: Execution payload bid gossip PR resolution (5774 vs 5776)
suggestions.rationale: Two competing approaches remain unresolved from #190: Potuz/Justin's proposer-accepts-any vs. Nico's 3% minimum increment. Client teams were asked to weigh in within days but no decision recorded in #191.

suggestions.topic: PQ deposit contract front-running requirement confirmation
suggestions.rationale: EIP-8205 DFI'd in #190 with explicit requirement that PQ deposit contract must address front-running. No update on whether PQ design teams have incorporated this constraint.

suggestions.topic: Hegota EIP scoping progress: bundled attestations, retention window, custom sweep
suggestions.rationale: EIPs 8334, 8383, 8148, and 8411 all CFI'd in #190; teams should confirm implementation readiness and any blocking issues before advancing to SFI.

suggestions.topic: PQ Gasper feasibility and DC compatibility roadmap
suggestions.rationale: Explored in #191 as potential faster path than FOCIL+DC, but feasibility uncertain. Teams noted aggregation, bandwidth, and non-finality handling all require investigation before commitment.
